name: Launch (SDLC Phase 11)
description: Executing the product launch — aka Go-Live, GA, Rollout, Ignite.
owner: SDLC Templates — NoteShare Pro Reference Library

capabilities.name: Launch Management
capabilities.description: Executes the coordinated go-live of the product, including rollout sequencing, monitoring, and incident readiness.

checklists.statement: The launch checklist, rollout plan, and incident response plan are complete and all owners have confirmed readiness.
checklists.prompt: Have all owners confirmed readiness against the launch checklist, rollout plan, and incident response plan?

reviewGates.statement: The Launch's deliverables have been reviewed and accepted as sufficient to proceed to Hypercare & Stabilization.
reviewGates.prompt: Was the launch executed against the rollout plan with monitoring and communications in place, justifying the move into Hypercare & Stabilization?
